recall.uz: Bahor haqidagi sheʼrni tinglab oʻqiymiz, rasmlarning birinchi harfidan soʻz tuzamiz va bahor belgilarini topamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем стихотворение о весне, составляем слово из первых букв картинок и находим приметы весны.
recall.en: We read a poem about spring, build a word from the pictures' first letters, and find the signs of spring.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.en: Who works in the field in spring?

explanation.uz: Sheʼr bahor kelishi va tabiatning uygʻonishi haqida.
explanation.ru: Стихотворение о приходе весны и пробуждении природы.
explanation.en: The poem is about the arrival of spring and nature waking up.

meaning.ru: Bahor — весна, самое красивое время года.

prompt.uz: Rasmlarni chapdan oʻngga bosib, yashiringan soʻzni oching!
prompt.ru: Нажимай картинки слева направо и открой спрятанное слово!
prompt.en: Tap the pictures left to right to reveal the hidden word!

hint.uz: Har bir rasm nomining birinchi harfini ol.
hint.ru: Возьми первую букву названия каждой картинки.
hint.en: Take the first letter of each picture's name.

explanation.uz: baraban, asal, humo, olov, robot → B-A-H-O-R → BAHOR.
explanation.ru: барабан, мёд, хумо, огонь, робот → B-A-H-O-R → BAHOR.
explanation.en: drum, honey, humo, fire, robot → B-A-H-O-R → BAHOR.

statement.en: In spring the farmer sows seeds in the field.

why.ru: В стихотворении сказано, что сеют семена.
why.en: The poem says seeds are sown into the ground.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: What is sown in the field?

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri: bahorda dehqon yerga urugʻ ekadi.
explanation.en: True: in spring the farmer sows seeds.

statement.ru: В стихотворении говорится, что идёт снег.
statement.en: The poem says it is snowing.

why.uz: Sheʼr bahor haqida; qor haqida gap yoʻq.
why.ru: Стихотворение о весне; о снеге ничего нет.
why.en: The poem is about spring; snow is not mentioned.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: Is the word “snow” in the poem?

explanation.uz: Bahorda gullar ochiladi, qushlar sayraydi, daraxtlar kurtak yozadi.
explanation.ru: Весной цветут цветы, поют птицы, деревья дают почки.
explanation.en: In spring flowers bloom, birds sing, trees bud.

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

explanation.uz: chechan = chaqqon; borliq = olam; toʻlgʻanmoq = toʻlqinlanmoq.
explanation.ru: chechan = ловкий; borliq = мир; toʻlgʻanmoq = волноваться.
explanation.en: chechan = nimble; borliq = the world; toʻlgʻanmoq = to ripple/surge.

choices.ru: Пора, когда природа просыпается и цветёт
choices.en: The season when nature wakes and blooms

prompt.en: What kind of season is spring, according to the poem?

hint.en: What does nature do in the poem?

explanation.uz: Bahor — tabiat uygʻonadigan, gullaydigan koʻrkam fasl.
explanation.ru: Весна — пора, когда природа просыпается и расцветает.
explanation.en: Spring is the season when nature wakes up and blooms.

openEnd.uz: Sen bahorni qanday soʻzlar bilan taʼriflagan boʻlarding?
openEnd.ru: Какими словами ты описал бы весну?
openEnd.en: What words would you use to describe spring?

prompt.en: Build the proverb from the words!

explanation.uz: «Yilning kelishi bahordan maʼlum»: yaxshi boshlanish yaxshi natija belgisi.
explanation.ru: «Каким будет год — видно по весне»: доброе начало — залог доброго конца.
explanation.en: “How the year will be is seen from spring”: a good start foretells a good result.

clue.ru: Что из этого не время года?
clue.en: Which one is not a season?

hint.en: Three are seasons, one is not.

explanation.uz: Kitob — fasl emas; bahor, yoz, kuz esa fasllar.
explanation.ru: Книга — не время года; весна, лето, осень — да.
explanation.en: A book is not a season; spring, summer, autumn are.

clue.en: The first season of the year

prompt.en: Build the word from the syllables!
